text:
Harper: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount reprioritization. Short: prioritizing infra, SRE, product-security, and customer-facing roles for the next two quarters. We're not doing a hiring freeze but approvals tightened. People Ops will share an exceptions process. Ask here and we'll log answers.

Mika: What happens to reqs posted last month that are mid-interview?

People Ops: If req was posted before the announcement and has active finalists, continue interviews unless marked "low-priority" in the headcount sheet. If paused, recruiters will hold candidate outreach but honor any signed offers.

Recruiting: Can managers convert open contractor slots to FTE to prioritize continuity?

People Ops: Contractor->FTE conversions require a 1-paragraph ROI + headcount budget sign-off. Conversions that reduce net cost or are SLA-critical will be prioritized. Use the conversion form we'll link.

Sales Ops: For hires tied to Dedicated/Private deployments (enterprise wins), are they prioritized?

CTO: Customer-impacting revenue hires for Dedicated/Private are Priority=1. Attach the deal ID in the business case so Finance can fast-track approval.

R&D Lead: Any change to internship/apprenticeship intake? we rely on the grad cohort to staff some model ops roles.

People Ops: Intern/cohort intake is expected to continue but may be smaller this cycle. If your team relies on cohort labor, flag it in the headcount sheet so we can protect slots.

Mika: Will referral bonus timelines change? we have several near-hire referrals in pipeline.

People Ops: Referral program unchanged. If a referral reaches final-stage during the pause, Recruiting will keep timelines and offers intact.

Harper: Immediate manager actions: 1) add `org-pri` tag in Greenhouse for Priority=1 roles; 2) mark internal candidates `internal_candidate`; 3) add a one-line impact note for any req you want expedited. People Ops will compile a weekly exception list.

Hiring Bot: Shared link: https://redwood.internal/headcount-exceptions-2026 (internal) snapshot=1987654300

R&D Lead: One more: will team reorganizations (splits, new pods) be frozen?

People Ops: Non-headcount structural changes allowed but any change that increases headcount or repurposes roles needs approval. Temporary pods for critical launches can be requested as exceptions.

Harper: Thanks all. We'll post the exceptions template + quick FAQ in #all-hands-summary by EOD and run a 20-min office hour tomorrow 9:30am for managers.
